ambient_events: The beam swings past, and for half a second the whole basin is the colour of a cut wire.
Something under the foot of the tower shifts its weight. The water goes flat, then starts again.
The ribs hum. Not loudly — the way a wire hums, a long way off.
A gull banks hard away from the collar and does not come back.
description: The jetty ends under something nobody in Coldwater built. It stands on a black hexagonal foot that the basin does not lap against so much as part around, and above that the shaft pulls IN to a waist thinner than a man before it flares back out to carry a collar far wider than anything it holds up. Three ribs follow it down like the bones of a finger. The light at the top is a faceted drum of dark glass, and every ten seconds it comes round to you.
name: The Beacon
